### Speak Up for Those Who Cannot (Proverbs 31:8-9) - Your Daily Bible Verse - September 7
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-september-7.html
Passage: Proverbs 31:8-9
Points:
- Scripture provides a direct mandate for believers to advocate for the defenseless rather than remaining passive.
- Defending the voiceless begins with listening humbly to understand their needs.
- Prayer helps believers confront personal apathy and discover God's direction for using their gifts.
- True obedience translates faith into compassionate, practical action that pursues justice for neighbors.

### Choosing to Stand Up for Others - iBelieve Truth: A Devotional for Women - September 10, 2024
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/choosing-to-stand-up-for-others.html
Passage: Proverbs 31:8-9
Points:
- Silence in the face of mistreatment often stems from personal fear rather than an absence of love.
- Having someone stand in the gap brings profound relief and dignity to those suffering mistreatment.
- God calls believers to notice and defend the vulnerable, poor, and marginalized around them.
- Speaking up for those treated unfairly demonstrates tangible love for others and obedience to God.
